description: Sunken stone crypt open to the sky (39 by 36 m nave, raised side aisles, walls full of burial niches) with a water floor after the flood: the niches scatter the reflections (high spread, a weak flutter echo) and soak up the top end (more damping than the courtyard), so the tail is darker and a little longer than the courtyard's at about the same level. Measured on a sword hit with tools/audio/arena.py: tail energy 8.8 dB under the dry hit (courtyard 8.3), decay 1.5 s (courtyard 1.3 s; T30 extrapolated to 60 dB).
